our_interpretation: The ordinary reading concerns justified predictive accuracy, not the ability to print a probability with three digits after the decimal point.
For testing, three decimal places means demonstrated accuracy sufficient to justify rounding a probability on the zero-to-one scale to 0.001.

The post supplies neither a deadline nor a precise definition and time horizon for doom. A proposed counterexample must state these and address AI-caused extinction or comparably irreversible catastrophe.
criteria.support_condition: A decisive, independently scrutinized impossibility result establishes that the claimed accuracy cannot be attained for the relevant probability; continued lack of a method alone does not establish the forecast.
criteria.contradiction_condition: A publicly documented method achieves independently validated accuracy sufficient to justify three decimal places for a clearly specified, relevant AI doom probability.
